data.content_ref: inline:Replace the post-hoc greedy DefenseWitness construction with a canonical monotone fixed-point operator: for each accepted node x, D_x is the least set of accepted defenders satisfying closure under the defense relation; because the operator is monotone on a finite lattice, the least fixed point is unique and enumeration-order independent, so the contradiction in SRC_008 disappears while determinism and polynomial cost are retained.
